A little street sense

Three rides. Get home.

Drop the marked doorway rival, then board before another commuter takes the last seat. Win all three stops to complete the home run. Your score and health carry forward, with 25 health recovered between rides.

W A S D / ↑ ↓ ← →Move through the arena
JStrike the nearest rival. Tap or hold. Every third hit knocks them back.
FPower shove. Clear a crowd or interrupt a rival boarding. Recharges in 4 seconds.
K · holdBlock incoming hits. Time your guard for a perfect block.
L / SpaceDodge in your movement direction.
RPick up a bag or drink. Drinks restore health.
E · holdBoard after the doorway rival is down. Taking a hit interrupts you.
Esc / PPause and take a breath.

An orange ring means a rival is about to swing. Dodge, then strike while they recover. When the rival boarding bar appears, hit that commuter or board first.

 Fight for Trotro

Accra’s rush.
Turned up to eleven.

A fictional scramble for the last seat. Short rounds, readable combat, everyday objects, and the unmistakable energy of trying to get home.

Feel the fight

Combo shoves, bag swings, umbrella jabs, stamina, blocks, and perfectly timed dodges.

Know your city

Six location-inspired arenas, built for the game. The layouts are creative interpretations.

Make the escape

Win three contested seats. Drop the doorway rival, stop seat thieves, and hold Board to escape.

Character and surface art

Human models and motion from Microsoft Rocketbox. Asphalt by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven.

Google Maps links open the real locations for exploration. Street View imagery is not included in these arenas.
